about: Foundry tools: one fast standard command per chore. Run through ft.py so every run is logged. Add a tool: a folder <name>/ with tool.py + TOOL.md, and a row here.

tools.name: reading-copy
tools.purpose: Markdown -> same-version PDF (and --html, --docx) beside it, math and figures included

tools.name: look
tools.purpose: Screenshots of a page or HTML file at phone and desktop size, and whether named elements are visibly laid out or covered

tools.name: wait
tools.purpose: Workers only: wait without polling for a process, file or log line you started, with a time limit (stewards never wait on Anchor jobs)
tools.command: python C:/dev/foundry-tools/ft.py wait --pid N | --file PATH | --log PATH --line REGEX  [--max-min M]

tools.name: time-profile
tools.purpose: Where a job's or session's time went: commands vs model and other time, slowest steps, helpers written by hand

tools.name: ledger
tools.purpose: How code jobs are doing by size and model tier, why jobs miss landing, chores still done by hand, tool runs and proposals (read-only)

tools.name: model-pricing
tools.purpose: Instant local lookup and nightly sync (--sync) of OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and Grok models, small-job tiers, and API token list prices

tools.name: pdf-pages
tools.purpose: Inspect PDF page count, dimensions, per-page text, and optionally render page PNGs without custom scripts

tools.name: download
tools.purpose: Package or copy an HTML program or deliverable under a clean human filename with SHA-256 byte verification

tools.name: scout
tools.purpose: Proactively scan recent jobs, slow non-model steps, hand-written helpers, and tool proposals to detect workflow bottlenecks

tools.name: pptx-pdf-verify
tools.purpose: Convert .pptx slide decks to same-stem .pdf via LibreOffice and verify slide/page parity, selectable text, and slide bounds

tools.name: cst-rewrite
tools.purpose: Lossless LibCST/parso structural code rewriting, Parable of the Oranges (Juice/Peel/Pith) decomposition, and Hypothesis differential equivalence

tools.name: chrome-open
tools.purpose: Deterministically open one or more URLs or local HTML mockup files in John's visible Google Chrome window on WinSta0\Default

tools.name: docx-redline
tools.purpose: Convert Markdown (.md) to Word (.docx) (--from-md), inspect .docx styles/tracked changes (--inspect), diff two .docx files (--diff), or generate native OpenXML Track Changes (--redline) in 1s without custom scripts
